conditions.runtime: Unchanged entries are reusable only while the canonical registry digest and each rule dependency digest match

change.summary: Refresh the Registry Atlas effective index by changed rule delta

before.value: Recalculate every rule against every canonical object on each rebuild

after.value: Recalculate added or changed rules and reuse digest-verified unchanged entries

rationale.purpose: Reduce ordinary Atlas maintenance time without accepting stale effective entries

introduced.summary: Add digest-verified delta maintenance and an explicit full mode

history.summary: Preserve complete validation while limiting expensive registry matching to changed rules

relations: Rule digest and canonical registry digest -> safe cache reuse -> compact effective index
